answer_1.quote: In this paper, we tackle the problem of automatic generation of football commentary.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation of the generated commentary by two of the authors.
answer_4.guideline: We assess three aspects—Accuracy, Relevance, and Ease of Understanding—defined in this work, and we adopt a 3-point rating scale following prior practice in live text commentary evaluation (Taniguchi et al., 2019).
